CustomField.description: When the actual achievement rate falls short of the target achievement rate by more than 1%, a notification will be triggered.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( TEXT(Target_Year__c) = TEXT(YEAR(TODAY())), TEXT(Target_Month__c) = TEXT(MONTH(TODAY())), (Up_to_Date_Tonnage_Ach__c - Actual_Chargeable_Weight_Ach__c) > 0.01 ), OR( TODAY() = DATE(VALUE(TEXT(Target_Year__c)), VALUE(TEXT(Target_Month__c)), 16), TODAY() = (DATE(VALUE(TEXT(Target_Year__c)), VALUE(TEXT(Target_Month__c)) + 1, 1) - 1 - 7), AND( TODAY() >= (DATE(VALUE(TEXT(Target_Year__c)), VALUE(TEXT(Target_Month__c)) + 1, 1) - 1 - 5), TODAY() <= (DATE(VALUE(TEXT(Target_Year__c)), VALUE(TEXT(Target_Month__c)) + 1, 1) - 1) ) ), false )
CustomField.label: Not Achieved
